answer: Dune diversity bond: each identity locks 70 credits and trades with 12 distinct counterparties, 3 anchor traders co-signing trades. The dune ledger publishes the diversity signal; auditors slash bonds that collapse to a clique. The k-th trade costs 6+2(k-1); 12 cost 204; 1,000 fakes pay 204,000 plus 70,000 locked against a 40,000 pool. A rented anchor co-signing a fake trade loses both. An honest agent pays 204 once and reclaims its bond.
